mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates the Federal Reserve is shifting to an easing stance, lowering discount rates and increasing equity present value, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for 3 consecutive months signals tightening monetary policy, raising discount rates and compressing equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% for 3 consecutive months, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the 10-year Treasury yield for 3 consecutive months indicates expectations of lower future inflation and policy easing, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of periods where GS10Y declines for 3 consecutive months, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the 10-year Treasury yield above 4% for 3 consecutive months signals policy tightening and higher discount rates, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of periods where GS10Y exceeds 4% for 3 consecutive months, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in nonfarm payrolls for 3 consecutive months indicates a strengthening labor market, raising consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of periods where PAYEMS increases for 3 consecutive months, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly decline in nonfarm payrolls for 3 consecutive months signals a weakening labor market, lowering consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS < previous month for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of periods where PAYEMS declines for 3 consecutive months, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in unemployment claims for 3 consecutive months indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer and business confidence and compressing equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of periods where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp over 3 months, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in industrial production for 3 consecutive months indicates weakening domestic demand or supply constraints, compressing corporate earnings and equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in < 40% of periods where INDPRO declines for 3 consecutive months, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.
